unit.reason: 70 focused usage-limit and governess tests passed independently and in Harness.

integration.reason: 830 tests passed; the four failures are unchanged Codex default/config expectation baselines in paired-options.test.ts and runner.test.ts, outside the modified files.

transient_and_partial_retention.evidence: The stateful reader caches Claude and Codex independently. A pricing-only failure restores both fresh provider quotas, while a partial success refreshes the present provider and retains only the absent provider.

bounded_ttl.evidence: The live default is 60000 ms, timestamps refresh only when that provider has a current quota, and entries are removed once their age exceeds the bound.

auth_and_disabled_clear.evidence: An undefined underlying snapshot clears both provider entries. This covers missing URL/secret and exhausted 401/403 authentication. The checked-in auth regression passes; an independent disabled-reader transition probe also passed.

current_pricing_authoritative.evidence: The wrapper shallow-copies each current snapshot and changes only absent provider quota fields. An independent partial-response probe preserved a current 0.123 Codex credit value while retaining the other provider quota.

dependency_instance_isolation.evidence: createStableUsageLimitReader is evaluated once per defaultGovernessDeps call. An independent probe showed one dependency instance retained its quota through a 503 while a newly created dependency instance did not inherit it.

source_scope.evidence: Source changes are limited to governess usage-limit retention and wiring; the only other tracked changes are its regression test and Harness task metadata.

live_run_50.evidence: Independent inspection confirmed harvto-loop-50 pane PIDs Claude 27090, Codex 27092, governess 32762, and worker 27542. Three refresh samples at 22:11:45, 22:12:01, and 22:12:18 retained Codex W9 and populated cost/rate ($12.48/$28, $12.48/$27, and $12.72/$28). Governess doctor returned ok with all checks true, a healthy journal, and zero pending, expired, superseded, or dead-letter bridge entries. The implementing-agent record places two direct tracker timeouts immediately before this independent stable-row observation.

caveats: The evaluator independently recaptured pane identity, three post-timeout row refreshes, and doctor health; the two direct tracker timeout timestamps themselves come from the implementing-agent observation.
